title: Per-share upload opt-in + gameplay-view capture
summary: Sharing of highlight / summit / competition media is 100% opt-in, per-category, from the gameplay view (which rarely shows the avatar's face). Each upload requires a granted share_* consent record and goes through the M4 publish + moderation pipeline (#026). Default: nothing is uploaded.
deliverables: unity (gameplay-view capture + per-share opt-in -> M4 publish/moderation)

acceptance_tests.test: No highlight/summit/competition media uploads without the matching granted share_* consent record; uploaded media enters the M4 moderation path (#026).

history.event: created under AUTH #044 (opt-in sharing of gameplay-view media).

notes: Gameplay-view captures rarely show the face; still per-share opt-in + moderated (#026).
